Third-party libraries for the file preview (engine/viewer.js), loaded only when a file of that type is opened.
| file | library | version | licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| ../pdfjs/ | pdf.js (pdfjs-dist, legacy build + cmaps, standard fonts, wasm decoders) | 6.4.299 | Apache-2.0 |
| mammoth.browser.min.js | mammoth (DOCX → HTML) | 1.13.0 | BSD-2-Clause |
| xlsx.full.min.js | SheetJS Community Edition (XLSX/XLS/ODS/CSV…) | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 |
| jszip.min.js | JSZip (PPTX, ODT/ODP, EPUB, ZIP) | 3.10.2 | MIT (dual MIT/GPL-3.0) |
| heic2any.min.js | heic2any (HEIC/HEIF photos) | 0.0.4 | MIT |
| UTIF.js | UTIF.js (TIFF) | 3.1.0 | MIT |
| pako_inflate.min.js | pako inflate (used by UTIF for deflate TIFFs) | 2.x | MIT/Zlib |
